input.command:
python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np

img17 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0017.png')
# In obs 17: on the right foreground is potted_plant_2!
# Let's separate chair 2 (in background, ys < 400) from plant 2 (ys > 400)
c2_mask_17 = (img17[:,:,2] > 50) & (img17[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 380) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] < 400)
ys17, xs17 = np.where(c2_mask_17)
print('Chair 2 in obs 17 (ys<400): xs:', xs17.min(), xs17.max(), 'ys:', ys17.min(), ys17.max())
contact_y_17 = ys17.max()
center_x_17 = (xs17.min() + xs17.max()) / 2.0
d17 = 256.0 * 1.55 / (contact_y_17 - 255.5)
dx17 = (center_x_17 - 255.5) * d17 / 256.0
print(f'Obs 17: d={d17:.3f}, dx={dx17:.3f} -> x={dx17:.3f}, y={1.8 + d17:.3f}')
"
